card.name: Ending of lactic acidosis and overdose terms
card.fires_on: The last piece of a serious adverse-event term, such as "osis" in "lactic acidosis" or "overdose" after "opioid", and "of" after "signs and symptoms" in warnings about drug interactions.

modes.label: Lactic acidosis ending
modes.description: The "osis" ending of lactic acidosis in metformin interaction warnings.
modes.example: may increase the risk of metformin-associated lactic acid<<osis>>: those that impair renal function, result

modes.label: Opioid overdose
modes.description: The word overdose after opioid in advice about reversal agents.
modes.example: Inform patients and caregivers about opioid<< overdose>> reversal agents (e.g., nalox

modes.label: Symptoms of
modes.description: The word "of" after "signs and symptoms" before a muscle-injury term.
modes.example: monitor patients for signs and symptoms<< of>> myopathy, particularly during initiation of therapy

card.writes: It seems to push toward words for sudden emergencies, poisoning and catastrophe.
card.plain: It lights up at the end of named emergency-type harms like lactic acidosis or opioid overdose in warnings.
